sentences.text: Thus, the petitioner seeks a direction to the respondent authorities to scrupulously follow the procedure as provided under aforesaid Acts.
3. As seen from the material available on record, the respondents have already paid compensation to the claimant/writ petitioner.

If the amount determined by the respondent authorities is not acceptable, an alternative remedy is available to the petitioner to file an appeal as provided under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956 (hereinafter referred to as 'the Act').
4.
In view of the above, without going into merits of the case, the present Writ Petition is disposed of, granting liberty to the petitioner to file an appeal under 3G(5) of the Act.

On filing of such appeal,
the Arbitrator is directed to dispose of the appeal, within a period of two (02) months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order, strictly as per law.
The status-quo granted by this Court on 08.12.2025, stands vacated.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.
